senses.gloss: रोहिणी- + ईश रोहिणी- + ईश, m. the moon.

रोह रोह, i. e. रुह् + अ, m.
 1. A bud.
 2. Mounting, Rājat. 5, 15.

रोहक रोहक, i. e. रुह् + अक,
 I. adj. Riding, mounted on any vehicle.
 II. m. A sort of goblin.

रोहण रोहण, i. e. रुह् + अन,
 I. m. A mountain, Adam's peak in Ceylon, Pañc. MS. Berol., cf. Wilson in Trans. of the R.A.S. i. 169.
 II. n.
 1. Growing.
 2. Mountaing.
 3. Semen virile.

रोहिण रोहिण, i. e. रुह् + इन् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. The Indian fig-tree.
 2. A fragrant grass.
 II. n. A part of the forenoon. See रोहित.

रोहित् रोहित्, probably akin to रुधिर, ह् for ध्,
 I. m. The sun.
 II. f. The female of the black antelope.

रोहित रोहित, akin to रुधिर, ह् for ध्,
 I. adj., f. ता and इणी.
 1. Red.
 2. Coloured, Man. 1, 38.
 II. m.
 1. Red, the colour.
 2. A (kind of) deer, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 4.
 3. A fish, Cyprinas rohita, Man. 5, 16.
 III. f. इणी, also रोहिणि रोहिणि.
 1. The fourth lunar asterism, Vikr. 38, 12 (णी).
 2. The mother of बल-राम.
 IV. f. इणी.
 1. Lightning.
 2. A girl at the commencement of the menstruation, Pañc. iii. d. 213.
 3. A woman stained with red pigments.
 4. Inflammatory affection of the throat.
 5. A cow.
 6. Yellow myrobalan.
 7. Bengal madder.
 V. n.
 1. Blood.
 2. Safflower.
 3. The rainbow appearing in a straight form.

रोहिन् रोहिन्,
 I. रुह् + इन्, m.
 1. The Indian fig-tree.
 2. The holy figtree.
 II. (cf. रोकित्.) A stag, Rām. 5, 36, 35 (but perhaps is to be read रोहिन्-मांसम्, i. e. रोहित्-).
रोहिणी- + शकट रोहिणी- + शकट, m. or n. an asterism, probably αϐγδε Tauri, Pañc. 50, 20.
